subject.title: Discord: Support messageUpdate and messageDelete events for edit-to-reprocess and delete-to-cancel

question: Should Discord message edits/deletes become default channel behavior, and should deletes cancel only the exact source-message run while edits abort and reprocess the active revision?
rationale: Current main lacks the feature, but the open implementation changes session cancellation and message delivery semantics, which AGENTS.md treats as product- and compatibility-sensitive channel behavior.

options.title: Review linked PR semantics
options.body: Keep this issue open and use the linked PR as the active implementation candidate, requiring maintainer review and live Discord proof before merge.

options.title: Narrow to edit-only
options.body: Keep delete-to-cancel out of the first landing path and let the existing edit-only issue or a follow-up own cancellation semantics.

options.title: Reject channel-side cancellation
options.body: Close the linked PR and this issue only if maintainers decide Discord deletes should not affect active agent runs.

recommendation.title: Review linked PR semantics
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and use the linked PR as the active implementation candidate, requiring maintainer review and live Discord proof before merge.
